messages:
camila: Hey team — first day here. My Okta MFA SMS didn't arrive to my Brazil number (+55 11 9XXXX-XXXX). Also 1Password invite redirected me to a redwood.co alias and then errored 'domain not allowed'. Who to ping?
it-support: Welcome @camila! Can you confirm the exact email you used? Also carriers in BR sometimes block shortcodes; we can try voice or passkey.
camila: camila@redwood.com. I used the link from HR email. Tried voice call, nothing.
pedro: I see a provisioning failure: the SSO redirect picked up an org alias `redwood.co` instead of `redwood.com`. Looks like the HR invite used an old alias. Re-sending correct invites now.
okta-bot: Okta: enrollment email resent to camila@redwood.com (job 9123). SMS/voice attempted. Status: pending.
people-ops: Sorry about the alias — we had a stale template. Fixed and reissued the 1Password invite from the correct domain.
1password-bot: 1Password: invite sent to camila@redwood.com (expires in 7 days). Admin resend flagged.
camila: Tried the new Okta link but the SSO chooser showed my personal Google account by default and it failed. Cleared cookies and used incognito, worked. But SMS still doesn't come.
it-support: For Brazil numbers we usually enable WebAuthn. I've provisioned a temporary passkey for you (24h). Also security will ship a backup YubiKey.
security: We'll mail a YubiKey to your address in Brazil; ETA 4-6 business days.
camila: Passkey enrollment succeeded, 1Password set up, all done. Thanks for the quick assist :raised_hands:
